about.pdfSummary: More than fifteen years in software, starting as a developer. For more than ten years, leading as well as building, and for over five of those years technical direction was the core of the job. Dozens of clients, from fashion and retail to banking and insurance, and work with system integrators and delivery partners. With the client, from the need and the solution through to production, except the sale. Accountable after go-live. Hiring interviews, and evaluation of people’s performance and results.
